youtube.title: Inter's greatest goalkeeper ever: Zenga or Júlio César? #Shorts
youtube.description:
Inter's greatest goalkeeper ever — Zenga or Júlio César? We picked Zenga. Your turn.
The Italian Inter press in English every morning, free: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?v=debate1

THE DEBATE — a weekly fan-made argument, not the news.
Walter Zenga (1982–94): 473 Inter games, a club record for a goalkeeper; IFFHS World's Best Goalkeeper 1989, 1990 and 1991; 2 UEFA Cups, 1 Scudetto.
Júlio César (2005–12): 300 Inter games; five trophies in 2010 including the Champions League; Serie A Goalkeeper of the Year 2008–09 and 2009–10.
Also in the frame: Gianluca Pagliuca, Francesco Toldo, Samir Handanovič, Yann Sommer.
Sources: inter.it Hall of Fame, IFFHS, uefa.com, Lega Serie A, Wikipedia.
Fan-made — not affiliated with FC Internazionale Milano.
#Inter #ForzaInter #SerieA #Goalkeeper #Zenga #Shorts
